title: Guard GitHub CLI remote attribution
summary: Add a local guard for the active GitHub CLI account so remote-write tooling does not attribute autonomous work to a personal operator account even when Git commit metadata is neutral.
expectedFailureModes: Git author and committer metadata are neutral but GitHub CLI writes are attributed to a personal account.
The pre-push hook checks commit metadata but misses authenticated tooling state.
Validation fails in CI because GitHub CLI is unavailable or unauthenticated.
humanEscalation: Provision a repository-owned GitHub or deploy-key actor if push-event attribution must stop resolving to an individual SSH-key owner.
nextAction: Use the neutral account guard before remote writes and continue autonomous backlog execution.
